facts.fact: The Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (Act 4 of 2013) was assented to on 19 November 2013 and gazetted on 26 November 2013, and its section 115 says it commences on a date the President proclaims, with different dates allowed for different provisions.
The Act provides for an Information Regulator established in terms of section 39 to exercise powers and perform duties under it.
